issues.description: generate-stories imports torch before the generation branch and then requires an existing stories manifest, so clean dataset generation is broken.
Configured story dataset directory is empty, so extract/all cannot run from a clean checkout.
Integration fixture assumes real model access and story data but does not skip or fail clearly when prerequisites are missing.
Story loader does not validate manifest consistency, missing files, empty files, or generated text quality before extraction.
External story-generation HTTP request has no timeout, retry, or response-shape validation and can hang indefinitely.
emotion_vectors silently produces NaNs when any configured emotion has zero examples.
pca_components does not handle zero-variance or degenerate inputs robustly and can return NaN ratios/components.
mean_activations can divide by zero for single-token or empty-tokenized inputs.
load_vectors trusts saved artifacts without validating model, emotion order, layer count, or vector dimensions against the current config.
test-all relies on marker expression behavior and still lacks prerequisite checks for model credentials/data, making CI usage fragile.
Ignored generated directories are present in the repo, including emovec.egg-info and outputs artifacts.
Runtime dependencies are broad lower bounds with no lock file, which weakens reproducibility for a research pipeline.
